description: This file defines the interface and class for a Rust plugin adapter within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It declares the LocalPlugin class, its methods, and internal function pointers for interacting with Rust code, along with relevant interface implementations and version-dependent features.

classes.name: LocalPlugin
classes.description: A class implementing a plugin interface for integrating Rust code within the WPEFramework, managing plugin lifecycle, communication, and callbacks.

methods.name: LocalPlugin
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin with configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given shell, version-dependent.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method via JSON RPC, with different signatures based on version.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method, version-dependent.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the local dispatcher, placeholder implementation.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific channel.
